title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu (IGNOAPS)
official_title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
administering_authority: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Under the NSAP umbrella in Tamil Nadu, IGNOAPS provides a monthly pension of ₹1,000, along with free dhotis/sarees and subsidized rice, to destitute elderly citizens aged 60 and above belonging to BPL households.

benefits.description: Monthly social security pension of ₹1,000 via DBT, free dhoti/saree distributed during Pongal and Deepavali, and 2kg-4kg free rice per month.
conditions: Applicant must be aged 60 years or older
Must be a destitute individual with no steady means of subsistence
Must belong to a household Below Poverty Line (BPL) in Tamil Nadu

rules.explanation: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu.

required_documents.name: Smart Ration Card / Address Proof
required_documents.condition: Proof of residence in Tamil Nadu

required_documents.name: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / School Certificate)
BPL Certificate / Card Number
required_documents.condition: Proof of BPL status issued by competent authority

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook
required_documents.condition: Active bank account for monthly pension credit

application_steps.description: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (TNeGA e-Sevai centre) or Taluk Office / Revenue Inspector.
Submit application form along with Aadhaar, age proof, smart ration card, and BPL details.
Village Administrative Officer (VAO) and Revenue Inspector (RI) conduct field inquiry into destitution status.
Special Tahsildar (Social Security Schemes) issues sanction order upon verification.
